name: Engine: draw kana and kanji in the game UI
body: The engine's font is an 8x8 bitmap of ASCII, so the Japanese minigame can only show romaji. Needs a font with kana and kanji (a texture atlas of glyphs, or a vector font) and UTF-8 text in lantern:::overlay:::Text and the UI text widget. Not a Nyx gap: the engine and the font asset. Filed on the Lantern board.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the six rooms and the crossing: the game feels like an action adventure (grounded movement, challenge from places and small games), not a puzzle platformer.
Left todo: needs engine work (a glyph atlas or a vector font), not a Nyx change. The word market uses romaji until then.

acceptance_criteria: Kana and kanji draw in a Chaos text element
